command: cooperbench run -n coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-core-ref-delivery-timing -s core -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m vertex_ai/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/variants/delivery_timing_medium.yaml --setting coop -c 4 --backend docker --git
agent_config:
# Variant config based on configs/reference/medium.yaml (500 steps, 128K compaction, medium thinking).
# Holds non-blocking incoming messages until natural workflow boundaries (clean test/git/PR
# Pass via: AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/delivery_timing_medium.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=ref-delivery-timing tools/run.sh coop flash 4 --git
agent:
  cost_limit: 40.0
  step_limit: 500
  compaction_token_trigger: 128000
  step_counter: true
  delivery_timing: true
  delivery_max_hold_steps: 4
  delivery_boundary_mode: natural

environment:
  container_timeout: "10h"

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: medium
      includeThoughts: true
